title: House Science Committee advances 10 bipartisan AI bills
summary: The committee reported bills on research compute access (CREATE AI Act), AI security, flaw reporting, provenance, workforce and data-center energy measurement; Senators also introduced the AI Labeling Act.
reason: Non-prescriptive bills advancing; words more than action.

title: RAISE US launches with $500M+ to retrain workers for the AI economy
summary: A nonprofit led by Gina Raimondo and Eric Holcomb launched with Amazon, Anthropic, Microsoft and the OpenAI Foundation as anchors, targeting $1B for state reskilling partnerships.
